item.title: Wild Card Brewing announces relocation, partnership with Barnstormer
item.description: 'Rather than letting setbacks stop us, we found a way to keep brewing, keep employing and keep serving our customers,' Innisfil-based craft brewery says of move into Barrie

item.title: New musical born from 'YouTube rabbit hole about bluefin tuna butchers'
item.description: Talk Is Free Theatre's production of 'All The Cows Are Dead' will run Jan. 22-31 at 80 Bradford St.

item.title: Morning travel disruptions likely due to snow and ice
item.description: Drivers are being urged to prepare for slippery roads and reduced visibility as up to eight centimetres of snow combined with freezing drizzle is forecast across parts of Ontario starting late Monday night

item.title: B.C. health authority wins in court against husband's 'death plan' for sick wife
item.description: The B.C. Supreme Court has ordered the husband of a woman with Alzheimer's disease removed as her representative over a "death plan" he decided to carry out if his wife became ineligible for medical assistance in dying.

item.title: 'It was only half the weight': Customer calls out errors at grocery store
item.description: A Food Basics customer recently found that two packages of meat he purchased were over a kilogram lighter than advertised

item.title: 'Independent state?' Proposed referendum question approved on Alberta separation
item.description: EDMONTON — Alberta's election agency announced Monday it has approved a proposed referendum question on the province separating from Canada.

item.title: Judge accepts plea deals from Colorado funeral home owners who acknowledged abusing 191 corpses
item.description: DENVER (AP) — A state judge on Monday accepted plea agreements for the owners of a Colorado funeral home for the abuse of 191 corpses, many of which languished in a room-temperature building for years, over the objections of relatives of the victims.

item.title: Toronto police say officer shot stabbing suspect, police watchdog to investigate
item.description: TORONTO — Toronto police say an officer shot a stabbing suspect in the city's north end and the province's police watchdog will investigate the incident.

item.title: Pulled '60 Minutes' segment surfaces on web with Canadian broadcaster's branding
item.description: A segment of the American news program "60 Minutes," pulled by CBS News prior to its U.S. airing, began circulating online Monday with the branding of Canadian broadcaster Global TV.

item.title: At least 5 killed after Mexican Navy plane on medical mission crashes in Texas
item.description: A small Mexican Navy plane transporting a young medical patient and seven others crashed Monday near Galveston, killing at least five people and setting off a search in waters along the Texas coast, officials said.
